criterion_text: The document is a review-type study (systematic review, scoping review, or other literature review) that synthesizes existing published literature, rather than reporting a single primary empirical study or a purely conceptual framework paper with no literature synthesis.

The document substantively addresses disaster risk reduction (DRR) or resilience to hazards, with an explicit hazard/disaster framing -- general risk, climate adaptation, or sustainability content without an explicit hazard/disaster context does not satisfy this criterion.

The document substantively analyses at least one of the following governance dimensions in a DRR/resilience context: institutional capacity, decentralization, multilevel governance, partnerships, civil society, capacity building, community participation, education/training, financing, legal/regulatory frameworks, information systems, or urban planning. Passing mention of government actors without substantive analysis of one of these dimensions does not satisfy this criterion.
